scope: Actual production studio UI with isolated synthetic accounts, project/catalog/account APIs. No live providers, billing or physical-device verification.

results.name: Home enters through shared 280ms tokens without replaying for prompt/data changes
Desktop collapse/expand keeps accessible links and focus; visual preference survives routes/reload
Library views keep their panel; search results stay steady; preview/processing/permissions remain explicit
Project inspection/search does not switch ownership; creation forms survive collapse; archive/restore uses existing operations
Settings keeps native hash focus and all panel state; billing/recovery stays explicit
Rapid route changes work during entry and cancel the obsolete animation without delayed navigation
Five widths, desktop keyboard collapse, native mobile focus trap/return, touch, EN/ES, dark mode and axe checks
Reduced motion stays functional; account/Free gates remove private catalog data without content, AI or billing mutations
